title: PHANTOM GRID Root-of-Trust Intent Lock & 5Gbps Swarm State Recovery

Line-rate throughput surges to 5.00 Gbps across CAN-FD and SOME/IP backbones. In eighteen microseconds, deterministic global state rollback reconstitutes the vehicle to one hundred percent operational integrity. All recovery cycles are signed with immutable SHA-256 cryptographic seals.
